For a glove box, tackle box, or pack, larger knife not a issue.

We bought this black picnic blanket to use as a substitute cover in back of our SUV. To purchase a cargo cover was just too expensive. This blanket works great, can't see do-dah thru the back windows. For the price I figured it'd be cheaply made, but to our surprise it's a good quality product. I know some thought it a bit too slippery on the shiny side, but we haven't picnicked on any hills lately so can't address that issue. The way it folds into a case with a handle is pretty cool also.
